- Build a complete, playable 2D Dragon Ball Z-inspired fighting game for phones/tablets, with selectable characters and AI opponents at multiple difficulty levels.

- Support phone/tablet layouts and usable touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for checks.

- Created original, anime-inspired fighters and names rather than using Dragon Ball Z characters directly.
- Implemented the game as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript canvas game with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added fighter selection, opponent selection, three AI difficulty levels, arena UI, health/energy meters, timer, combat effects, AI, results/rematch, and sound toggle.
- Added responsive layouts and mobile touch controls.

- Verify gameplay and visuals in-browser, then fix any issues found.

- Build a complete, playable anime-inspired 2D fighting game for phones and tablets, with selectable fighters and AI opponents at multiple difficulty levels.

## Requirements
- Make the game playable without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone/tablet layouts and usable touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Use original anime-inspired fighters and names rather than Dragon Ball Z characters.
- Implement as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript canvas game.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added fighter/opponent selection, three AI difficulty levels, arena UI, health/energy meters, timer, combat effects, AI, results/rematch, and sound toggle.
- Added responsive layouts, keyboard controls, and mobile touch controls.
- Fixed touch movement to use held directional controls and allowed touch attack/blast/jump presses to register.
- Updated game title to “ZENITH — Cosmic Showdown,” removed the missing favicon request, and revised the arena tip.
- `node --check game.js` passes; browser test observed health changing and timer counting down.
- Captured `screenshots/setup.jpg`, `screenshots/arena.jpg`, and `screenshots/mobile-arena.jpg`.

### Active
- Continue browser testing and fix remaining gameplay issues, especially touch control behavior, attack reliability, AI, and round results.

### Blocked
- Touch attack test did not change health; needs investigation to determine whether the test missed the opponent or touch presses are still not registering correctly.

## Next Move
1. Inspect attack timing, hit ranges, and touch event behavior in-browser; verify both player and AI attacks affect health.
2. Test jump, guard, KI blast, AI difficulty, and victory/defeat/rematch behavior.
3. Fix issues found, rerun checks, and capture updated screenshots if needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI markup.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Fighter roster, drawing, input, combat, AI, and game loop.
- `screenshots/`: Setup, arena, and mobile-arena JPEG screenshots.

## Important Context
- A local server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The browser initially reported missing `/favicon.ico`; an inline data favicon was added.
- Changes are uncommitted.
